# Dependency versions

Versions bundled with mitr. These describe the checked-in sources, not
the latest available releases.

| Library | Version | Release Date | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SDL2 | 2.30.10 | 2024-12-27 | zlib | https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/releases |
| SDL2_ttf | 2.22.0 | 2024-01-22 | zlib | https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL_ttf/releases |
| FreeType | 2.13.3 | 2024-08-12 | FTL (selected) | https://download.savannah.gnu.org/releases/freetype/ |
| Fontconfig | 2.18.3 | 2026-08-06 | MIT-style | https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/fontconfig/fontconfig/-/releases |
| Expat | 2.8.5 | 2026-09-22 | MIT | https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/releases |
| gperf | 3.3 | 2025-04-20 | GPLv3+ | https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/gperf/ |
| zlib | 1.3.2 | 2026-02-17 | zlib | https://zlib.net/ |
| libyaml | 0.2.5 | 2020-06-01 | MIT | https://github.com/yaml/libyaml/releases |
| log.c | 0.1.0 | 2020-02-07 | MIT | https://github.com/rxi/log.c |

See [README.md](README.md) for build and update instructions and
[NOTICE](../NOTICE) for license texts and attribution. gperf is a build tool
and is not linked into mitr. FreeType is used under the FreeType License;
its alternative GPL license is not selected.
